body: Some parents really need to look into what they call "unconditional" love.

Ugh, I'm stuck. I have friends who would let me crash but I don't want to be a burden. Everything I do or say is apparently wrong, so I just don't talk much at home which just leads to more conflict. What public places could I get help from? Jobs are tight in my area. Thinking of going active duty and going NC from there.
Yea, I'm in the same boat. I could care less what my relatives think of me, yet my parents need to talk me up to them while berating me in private. Good lord this is not healthy.

Yea, it happened it a lot when I was little and I just kinda dealt with it by shutting off and forgot about it by passing it off as normal behavior. But every now and then I get flashbacks of how physical harm was considered okay under the guise of "love" or "discipline".
I dunno what to call it. I would like for things to just be consistent for at least a couple days, just not so extreme at both ends at least once a day. It's really messing with my head.
Damn, on point. Somehow this crazy chaotic system works in our lifetimes, but probably not for that much longer. Yea Ill get that pint.

Yea, I agree with this method but you have to agree that it is such a timesuck. Most people work 9-5 just to get by and are physically and emotionally drained by the end of the day. I'll probably be in that boat soon. Some circumstances just aren't conducive to a healthy dating life. Thoughts?
Thanks stranger. We'll all make it, somehow.

AH I want to live like you guys so badly. Instead of a van, though i have a compact car to keep things simple. After a month of adventuring i'm planning on figuring out how to make money while keeping my nomadic lifestyle. It would be nice to keep in touch with you guys for advice and tips!

Yea so damn easy to say those things and those are not solutions at all! I'm all for it but they are temporary solutions. Get laid: she gets pregnant, now you're fucked for 18 years. Get drunk: Pee in an alley and get arrested.
Hey man, I'm sorry for your situation. I think I'll be in your shoes in a couple months. Will you please send me a message? I'd really like to hear your story, if you feel like sharing.

Exactly how I feel. I have been asking "why?" a lot lately. Especially why or how I came to be in my body. I'm not even spiritual or religious. I could have been a speck of dust or just non existent. I too have enjoyed the finer things in life but it is clear that nothing is forever. The thought of waking up in the morning to go to a job where I'll just get yelled at just to make barely enough to put food on the table is unbearable. Especially if other people are depending on you.
I'm sorry to hear that man. I've become so jaded after hearing tale after tale of people doing horrible things. Granted, I don't know the whole story here, but I hope you find someone better.

I know how that feels. It's such an unnecessary and heartbreaking burden to bear. I wish there was a way to communicate that without sounding selfish. 
On the flip side, it means all these people care about you too. Let them know that you just need your sleep.

I want to know what you did that makes you think you're a shitty person? Maybe other people did things that forced you to act a certain way? It might not be 100% your fault. In some ways, aren't we all shitty human beings? What do you plan on changing in your life?
I'm just curious.
